title: 16-06-pace-code-c-2015.pdf — section 139
text:
8. The detainee, their solicitor or appropriate adult may make
representations to the custody officer that a document which is not
included in the table is essential and that a translation should be
provided. The reque st may be refused if the officer is satisfied that
the translation requested is not essential for the purposes described in
paragraph 1 above.

9. If the custody officer has any doubts about
• providing an oral translation or summary of an essential document
instead of a written translation, see paragraph 3;
 93
• whether the suspect fully understands the consequences of
waiving their right to a written translation of an essential
document, see paragraph 4, or
• about refusing provide a translation of a requested doc ument, see
paragraph 7,
the officer should seek advice from an inspector or above.
